note: Misses every stated criterion, which makes this the clearest out-of-ICP call in the batch. He is a nursing home care worker seeking a new job to raise his income, not a business owner or physician. On money he is not merely tight but distressed: overdrawn by $76, a credit score around 545 that disqualified him from third-party financing, a single debit card and no funds until payday. His health is not the neglected corner of an otherwise good life but an active chronic condition — diabetes managed with multiple daily medications — which is the crisis end of the scale the criterion explicitly excludes. And he is not going from good to great: at 6'2" and somewhere between 238 and 260 lb, having never trained and describing himself as an unhealthy kid and teenager who 'barely touched any exercise equipment', he is close to the literal exclusion the ICP names. Worth escalating that the rep did not disqualify — he ran the full process and then improvised progressively smaller payments to keep the deal alive. The stated ICP would have screened this call out at baseline, and the absence of any clinical criterion meant nothing screened it out on safety either.
